task.description: Write the test spec and test code for REQ-518 slice 2c-i-a (design r2a section 10.1: T-C1..T-C10, T-C12..T-C15, T-D1..T-D8, fixture 3.8, mutants assigned to 2c-i-a) and the SEC/REVIEWER merge conditions of steps 07 and 08. Tests per file only; no full suite; nothing committed.

result.summary: TESTS WRITTEN AND RUN PER FILE. 150 new test cases in 8 new files (plus 1 support module, 1 JSON fixture, 1 spec) and one forced 3-token edit of an existing test. Per-file results (mixlock taken and released around each run, one mix at a time, LOG_LEVEL=warning, no full suite, no multi-partition run, no mix letflow.check.test): query_scope 35/35, scope_allowed_set 21/21, scope_node_paths_allowed_ids 16/16, catalog_scope_declarations 25/25, scope_all_scan 17/17, api_pipeline_scope_set_error 9/9, scope_declaration 15/16, route_scope_exam_guard 10/11. THE TWO RED TESTS ARE IMPLEMENTATION DEVIATIONS, not test defects. BUG-1 (LOW): ScopeDeclaration.for_type/2 with a malformed prefix (empty, not a schema, tenant_xyz, a prefix with a double quote) raises (Postgrex.Error or ArgumentError) instead of returning :undeclared as design 3.2 and the moduledoc say; fail closed by exception, no data; fix: validate the prefix with TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 in for_types/2. BUG-2 (MINOR, SEC step-07 F-2): RouteScope.exam_route?/1 matches the prefix /modules/exam/ only, so a route at exactly /modules/exam escapes the R-1 guard; fix: path == /modules/exam or starts_with /modules/exam/. Both fixes are one-liners in lib/ (ELIXIR-DEV); the tests stay red until then. FORCED-1: test/letflow/routers/entities_query_restricted_walker_test.exs T-26 traced Compiler.compile/2 and run_aggregate/2 by arity and failed 2 tests after the arity change (ELIXIR-DEV counted only source-string hits); fixed by changing the three arities to 3, then 55/55. Existing files run one by one and green: query_test, query_joins_test, query_aggregate_test, query_cursor_field_grants_test, query_self_join_test, catalog_test, scope_test, service_task_entity_writes_sentinel_test, exam/certificate_test, exam/pack_install_test, exam/session_test, route_scope_walk_test, route_scope_test, authorization_enforcement_test, platform_scope_inventory_test, handler_writes_callers_test, install_activation_test. permission_matrix_test T24 fails only on this Windows checkout (CRLF in the CI yaml), unrelated. mix format --check-formatted over all new files and the edited test: exit 0. COVERAGE: AC 1 (T-C1 committed pre-change SQL of 8 shapes, arity, T-C3 guard incl {:nodes,[1]}, AST scan T-C2 with the five-site ledger and the router-literal/route-class tie); AC 2 (T-C4 rows/count/sum/group_by/cursor/page-2-under-narrower-set, T-C5 telemetry: one extra WHERE, one bound array, position); AC 3 (T-C7 LEFT keeps primary with NULL target, INNER drops, through NULLs far hop, ON-clause SQL shape of every hop, T-C8 undeclared target); AC 4 (T-D1..T-D8 incl prod-config evaluation of the allowlist key); AC 5 (T-C9/T-C10 statement counts); C-1/C-2/T-C12/T-C13 Scope half/T-C14; T-C15 scan + walk. AC 18 and 21 and the HTTP half of T-C13 are 2c-i-b by design (no route is reclassified here); stated in the spec. Not derivable here: ScopeGate memo, export reuse over HTTP, token/OIDC per-request shapes (existing suites), a :all value that travels through a variable (AST scan blind spot, residual for SEC). CI FIX (PR #2806, query_scope_test T-C1 latest_filter): the committed pre-change SQL listed the Latest schema columns captured from a stale _build; on main the Latest schema gained external_system/external_id, so the :latest shape differed in its SELECT column list only (not an implementation bug, not scope related; reproduced locally by running the test alone after a fresh compile). The test now replaces the SELECT column list by a marker on both sides for entity_record_latest queries (everything after FROM, params included, still compared exactly) and prints expected vs actual on failure. query_scope_test 35/35.

implementation_findings: BUG-1 (LOW): ScopeDeclaration.for_type/2 raises for a malformed prefix instead of :undeclared (design 3.2). Test: scope_declaration_test.exs 'a malformed prefix is :undeclared'.
BUG-2 (MINOR, SEC step-07 F-2): RouteScope.exam_route?/1 does not cover the bare /modules/exam path. Test: route_scope_exam_guard_test.exs 'a route exactly at the bare prefix'.
FORCED-1: entities_query_restricted_walker_test.exs traced Compiler.compile/2 and run_aggregate/2 by arity; fixed in this step (3 tokens).
OBS-1: the id list parameter is typed varchar[] ({:array, :string}), not text[]; one bound array either way.

OBS-2: SEC step-07 F-1 stands: a Postgrex.Error from the node reads is not mapped by handle_errors; api_pipeline_scope_set_error_test pins today's behaviour (conn untouched) and 2c-i-b must flip it together with the gate fix.

OBS-3: the scan blind spot (a :all that reaches the compiler through a variable, a function result or a module attribute) is a residual for SECURITY-REVIEWER; the fail-closed argument guard still refuses any value that is not :all, :none or {:nodes, [binary]}.
